Kishor Patil, Co-founder, CEO and MD, KPIT said, “The mobility industry continues to navigate
major shifts in technology priorities, investment cycles and business models. While some OEMs
are recalibrating programs in response to near-term pressures, the structural need for software-
led innovation, greater efficiency and faster time-to-market remains strong. Our Q2 FY27
performance is in line with expectations and reflects the early impact of our renewed strategy.
We are seeing broadening opportunities across Passenger Vehicles, Off-Highway and Trucks
segments. Our offerings in Connected Vehicles and Aftersales are gaining traction, while Beacon,
KPIT’s Mobility Intelligence product, is strengthening our strategic relevance with clients. Our AI-
led approach is helping clients address evolving priorities via differentiated solutions, improved
productivity and measurable business outcomes. We believe these shifts create significant
opportunities for KPIT. Our expanding capabilities, broadening market presence and AI-powered
offerings position us well for sustainable medium-term growth and margin expansion.”
Sachin Tikekar, Co-founder and Joint MD, KPIT said, “Our priority has been to build a more
diversified and resilient growth engine, and we are seeing tangible results. Despite a sharp
reduction in business from two of our largest clients, growth across several other existing and
new clients has enabled us to largely offset the impact and maintain a broadly stable revenue
base. We expect the decline in these two accounts to bottom out over the next couple of
quarters. Operationally, our focus is on scaling emerging accounts, converting opportunities
into executable programs, and improving the quality and predictability of delivery. We have
seen a marked improvement in our pipeline, supported by growing traction in US and India. The
Caresoft integration is strengthening our capabilities in Vehicle Engineering and Manufacturing
Consulting, creating new opportunities. We are also accelerating the adoption of AI across
engineering,
delivery
and
internal
operations
to
enhance
productivity,
speed
and
competitiveness. With sharper execution, greater account diversification and an increasingly
aligned organization, we are building a stronger foundation for sustainable growth.”

Financial Express: KPIT Leadership on 
Building Resilience and Agility
In a Financial Express feature, Kishor Patil, CEO & MD; 
Sachin Tikekar, President & Joint MD; Chinmay Pandit, 
Board Member & President – Americas; and Nirmala 
Pandit, Additional Non-Independent Non-Executive 
Director, shared perspectives on KPIT’s response to 
industry disruptions. The discussion covered 
leadership continuity, AI-enabled systems and growth 
opportunities across new regions and mobility 
segments.

”The real bottleneck is not software – it is 
validation”. 
Anup Sable highlights that validation and integration, not 
software development, are the biggest bottlenecks in 
Software-Defined Vehicles (SDVs), as AI accelerates code 
generation faster than testing can keep pace. He emphasizes 
automated regression testing, AI-driven defect analysis, and 
early platform validation as critical to enabling faster, safer, 
and scalable SDV development.

Speaking to Fortune India, Kishor Patil addressed the 
slowdown affecting European automotive clients and 
KPIT’s approach to navigating the changing market. 
He highlighted opportunities in the US, India and 
Southeast Asia, alongside investments in AI, mobility 
solutions and commercial and off-highway segments.

KPIT’s Perspective to NASSCOM 
DES 2026
At the NASSCOM Design & Engineering Summit 2026, 
Kishor Patil joined Dr. Janmejaya Sinha of Boston 
Consulting Group for a fireside conversation on India’s 
technology priorities. Gaurav Kakati delivered a keynote 
on AI’s impact on automotive engineering, highlighting 
domain knowledge, engineering context, governance 
and traceability. KPIT also participated through a 
technology showcase.
KPIT at CAR MBS 2026: Unlocking 
Value Through  Collaboration
At CAR MBS 2026, Chinmay Pandit represented KPIT on the 
executive panel “The Allied Response: Unlocking Value 
Across the Mobility Ecosystem.” The session explored how 
collaboration across OEMs, suppliers and technology 
partners can unlock value as the automotive industry 
becomes increasingly software-led and interconnected.

at AEK 2026
At the 30th edition of AEK, KPIT engaged with 
the automotive ecosystem on the transition 
towards AI-defined, data-driven mobility. 
Discussions covered in-vehicle AI, centralized 
computing, scalable E/E architectures and 
chiplet-based platforms.

ADAS Validation for Indian Roads at ETAuto Tech Summit
At the ETAuto Tech Summit, Mohit Kochar, CMO and Head of Global 
Alliances, KPIT, highlighted the importance of validating ADAS for 
India’s complex, real-world driving conditions. KPIT also showcased 
its mobility solutions alongside products from group company 
Technica Engineering, bringing engineering expertise and technology 
capabilities to the summit.
HANSER automotive: Reimagining Automotive Engineering 
with AI
In a feature for HANSER automotive, Kishor Patil explored how AI is 
reshaping vehicle design, development, validation and delivery. He 
explained how Mobility Intelligence can connect data, engineering 
tools and domain expertise to improve productivity, quality and 
collaboration.

KPIT and Vietsol Strengthen Southeast 
Asia’s Mobility Engineering Ecosystem
KPIT and Vietsol signed an MoU to collaborate on 
mobility software and engineering services across 
Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and the 
Philippines. The partnership will accelerate product 
development and support OEM engineering 
programs across the region.
IIT Ropar and KPIT Join Hands to 
Advance Defense R&D
IIT Ropar and KPIT Technologies signed an MoU to 
collaborate on defence research, development 
and indigenization. The agreement brings together 
academic research and engineering expertise to 
support indigenous defence technologies.

Technica Engineering participated at Automotive Testing Expo Europe 2026 in Stuttgart, showcasing its 
capabilities in testing and validating Software-Defined Vehicle architectures. The showcase focused on 
technologies supporting automotive communication, system validation and increasingly complex E/E 
development.

Kishor Patil, Co-founder, CEO and MD, KPIT said, “The mobility industry continues to navigate
major shifts in technology priorities, investment cycles and business models. While some OEMs
are recalibrating programs in response to near-term pressures, the structural need for software-
led innovation, greater efficiency and faster time-to-market remains strong. Our Q2 FY27
performance is in line with expectations and reflects the early impact of our renewed strategy.
We are seeing broadening opportunities across Passenger Vehicles, Off-Highway and Trucks
segments. Our offerings in Connected Vehicles and Aftersales are gaining traction, while Beacon,
KPIT’s Mobility Intelligence product, is strengthening our strategic relevance with clients. Our AI-
led approach is helping clients address evolving priorities via differentiated solutions, improved
productivity and measurable business outcomes. We believe these shifts create significant
opportunities for KPIT. Our expanding capabilities, broadening market presence and AI-powered
offerings position us well for sustainable medium-term growth and margin expansion.”
Sachin Tikekar, Co-founder and Joint MD, KPIT said, “Our priority has been to build a more
diversified and resilient growth engine, and we are seeing tangible results. Despite a sharp
reduction in business from two of our largest clients, growth across several other exi

sting and
new clients has enabled us to largely offset the impact and maintain a broadly stable revenue
base. We expect the decline in these two accounts to bottom out over the next couple of
quarters. Operationally, our focus is on scaling emerging accounts, converting opportunities
into executable programs, and improving the quality and predictability of delivery. We have
seen a marked improvement in our pipeline, supported by growing traction in US and India. The
Caresoft integration is strengthening our capabilities in Vehicle Engineering and Manufacturing
Consulting, creating new opportunities. We are also accelerating the adoption of AI across
engineering,
delivery
and
internal
operations
to
enhance
productivity,
speed
and
competitiveness. With sharper execution, greater account diversification and an increasingly
aligned organization, we are building a stronger foundation for sustainable growth.”
